FAQs

Frequently asked questions

Is minimally invasive knee replacement better?
It offers faster early recovery and smaller scars. Long-term results are the same as traditional surgery. Not all patients are candidates.
Who is NOT a candidate for minimally invasive TKR?
Very obese patients, those with previous knee surgery, severe deformity, or poor bone quality may not be candidates.
